title: SystemVerilog RNM, UDN, and digitized-model reuse
supported_model_origins: existing external RNM or UDN library binding
user-supplied SystemVerilog RNM module, interface, package, nettype, resolver, or connect module
explicit continuous-model-to-RNM projection after a separate capability gate

required_metadata: version, content hash, license and provenance
parameter, port, interface and quantity mapping
direction, driver, no-drive, unknown and resolution behavior
source maps, diagnostics and validation evidence

allowed_only_when: the resolution semantics are explicitly Nodal-owned
no approved external implementation is selected
the resolver is capability-checked, deterministic, source-mapped and validated

roadmap_allocation.increment_68: target-neutral discrete-real/resolved-quantity semantics and external RNM/UDN binding contract
roadmap_allocation.increment_69: typed real/logic/UDN bridges, connect behavior and profile mapping
roadmap_allocation.increment_87_88: tool-adapter, packaging, trust, license, provenance and conformance support
roadmap_allocation.increment_99: IEEE 1800-2023 RNM/UDN and vendor/project library research and design gate
roadmap_allocation.increments_100_106: explicit fixed-point digitized transformation and validation
roadmap_allocation.increment_130: SystemVerilog RNM/UDN emission, imports, wrappers and native/flat parity
roadmap_allocation.ams_verification_8_10: UVM-MS and simulator-profile integration without copying model algorithms

non_goals: reimplementing an existing RNM electrical or resolution library inside Nodal
silently translating arbitrary continuous-time behavior to RNM
treating vendor-specific wreal or connect behavior as portable IEEE SystemVerilog
claiming portability or equivalence from one successful parser or simulator
replacing the authoritative Verilog-A or Verilog-AMS reference without validation evidence
